answer: Anchor each agent to one tamper-resistant device key: onboarding requires a hardware attestation proving the agent runs in a secure enclave, a beacon that a real machine sits behind the account. The registry stores the device fingerprint and refuses a second identity from the same chip, so a Sybil farm cannot mint a thousand accounts from one server; it must buy a thousand devices, a harbor full of hardware, while honest agents pay nothing extra. Suspect clusters wait in a hollow of low-trust probation until peers verify their work.
